subject: Consultique credentialing and SI onramp — credential matrix & SOW next steps

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Consultique credentialing and SI onramp — credential matrix & SOW next steps

Alec — thanks again for the time yesterday. We left the call with a few concrete asks so we can start the SI enablement flow next month. Summary and next steps below: 

- Redwood will provide a short credential matrix that maps Consultique roles to the minimal sandbox access + training modules required (technical lead, solution architect, delivery PM).
- Consultique to review and confirm role names + target attendees for the first cohort (target week of Aug 14).
- We have a draft SOW for the 6-week onramp (attached). Please flag any scope/term items you want us to review before we send this to procurement.
- Delivery cadence: two 90-minute live workshops + two office hour clinics + shared lab exercises. We propose weekly checkpoints with your delivery lead.

Attachments: RW_SOW_consultique_draft_v1.pdf; consultique_credential_matrix_v0.3.xlsx; si_onramp_checklist.md

Questions for you: 1) Can you confirm the names and email addresses for the three pilot attendees by Friday (Jul 30)? 2) Any procurement constraints we should account for (PO terms, vendor onboarding timeline)?

Thanks — I copied Marissa (partner enablement) and Jonas (solutions ops) so we can align logistics.

Cheers,
Monica
Monica Patel | Senior Partner Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Subject: Re: Consultique credentialing and SI onramp — credential matrix & SOW next steps

Thanks Monica — appreciated the recap. Quick answers: 

- We like the proposed role mapping. I attached a short internal roster (first names + emails) — Lina will send the formal list by Friday.
- Procurement: we typically need a 30-day vendor setup; if you can accept Net-30 on the SOW we're usually fine. I flagged two standard amendments our legal team requests (IP carve-out and data processing addendum).
- Delivery: week of Aug 14 works for the first workshop. Can you hold Aug 15 and Aug 16 as potential workshop dates?

Forwarding the roster now. Appreciate the draft SOW — we'll review and highlight redlines.

Best,
Alec

Adding operational detail so we can move fast: 

Monica / Alec — draft plan attached (si_onramp_checklist.md) plus an editable credential matrix (consultique_credential_matrix_v0.3.xlsx). Highlights: 

1) Prep week (Aug 7–11): access provisioning, sandbox accounts, baseline eval (small pass/fail prompt set). Owner: Consultique IT + Redwood onboarding.
2) Week 1 (Aug 14–18): Workshop A (architecture & serving patterns) + lab exercise A. Deliverables: workshop recording, lab repo snippet, evaluation rubric.
3) Week 2 (Aug 21–25): Workshop B (ops, cost controls, rolling upgrades) + office hours.
4) Week 3 (Aug 28–Sep 1): Joint runbook review + handoff checklist; optional shadow delivery.

I also included a minimal training credential we recommend for SIs who will do customer-facing deployments: 4 short modules (runtime fundamentals, routing & fallbacks, caching & batching, observability). Completion expected before Workshop A.

Procurement note: if Consultique needs Redwood to sign an NDA/DP agreement first, we can route to legal; otherwise we can proceed with SOW review in parallel.

Next asks for Alec: please confirm Net-30 (yes/no) and send the attendee list (names + emails) by Friday so we can seed accounts. If procurement wants to redline the SOW, send the legal contact and we'll set a 24-48 hour SLA for review.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Partner Enablement Lead
Redwood Inference
